privacy_categories.description: Approximate location used for geofence-based order pickup notifications and weather-based menu recommendations. Not linked to user identity.
Phone number collected for account creation, order placement, and WhatsApp-based order confirmations.
User ID (phone number) used for loyalty points tracking, order history, and personalization.
Order history and app usage patterns for personalized recommendations and analytics.
Purchase history for order tracking, loyalty points, and receipt generation.

third_party_sdks.name: Firebase (Google)
third_party_sdks.purpose: Backend database, cloud functions, push notifications, analytics

third_party_sdks.name: Razorpay
data_collected: Payment information (processed by Razorpay, not stored by app)

notes.encryption: The app uses HTTPS (TLS) for all network communication. No custom encryption algorithms are used. This qualifies for the encryption exemption under Category 5 Part 2 of the EAR.
notes.tracking: The app does NOT use the App Tracking Transparency framework as it does not track users across other companies' apps or websites.
